results.content: Search Engine Journal reports on University of Washington research showing a drop in Wikipedia pageviews. Bottom line of the research is a 5% drop due to Google AI overview, the summaries that many Google users read (and rarely click further). The paper has not yet been peer-reviewed, uses some novel techniques to compare traffic from different geographic areas that had or didn't have the preview feature during its 2024 rollout.
